fusions.name: Tag the Quarry
fusions.desc: Flicks a burr at the first enemy in line up to 8 tiles away, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered at Last
fusions.desc: A closing blow that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Pounce Prepared
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
